summary: Iteration 13: Full testing of Social Sharing feature for skin collection showcase. Backend GET /api/showcase/share-text/{wallet} endpoint working correctly. All 10 backend tests PASS. Frontend share modal, Twitter/X, Telegram, Copy Link, and Copy Text buttons all verified working.

Backend: Response contains share_text, stats, hashtags, mentions fields
Backend: Stats include total_owned, total_skins, completion_percent, has_ethereal
Backend: Share text contains collection info and emojis for engagement
Backend: Share text mentions @BullpugSOL
Backend: Hashtags include Bullpug and Solana
Backend: New collector gets starter share text with encouragement
Backend: Total skins count matches between share-text and showcase endpoints
Backend: Server running confirms WebSocket managers imported correctly
Backend: P2P Pot endpoint works confirming pot_ws_manager import
Frontend: Share button (data-testid='share-btn') visible on showcase page
Frontend: Share button visible for non-owners (all visitors can share)
Frontend: Share modal opens with dynamic share text preview
Frontend: Twitter/X button (data-testid='share-twitter-btn') visible with correct #1DA1F2 color
Frontend: Telegram button (data-testid='share-telegram-btn') visible with correct #0088cc color
Frontend: Copy Link button (data-testid='copy-link-btn') visible and clickable
Frontend: Copy Text button (data-testid='copy-text-btn') visible and clickable

Frontend: Twitter URL uses correct intent format (twitter.com/intent/tweet)
Frontend: Telegram URL uses correct share format (t.me/share/url)
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality: share-text endpoint properly generates dynamic text based on collection status (new collector vs collector vs mythic holder)
Code quality: WebSocket managers correctly moved to utils/websocket_managers.py with singleton instances
Code quality: Frontend share functions properly encode URLs and text for safe sharing
Code quality: Share button accessible to all visitors, not restricted to showcase owner
seed_data_creation: No new seed data needed. Used existing TEST_giftflow_recipient_ebb244d0 wallet.
